description: This course allows students to conduct Physics research. Students can undertake literature review and work on experiments using techniques related to synthesis, characterisation and applications. After completing this course, students will acquire some competence in analysing problems in Physics and proposing viable solutions. This course is enhanced with the Research Experience Programme, where students attend seminars and workshops, access writing consultations, receive a grant to do independent research, and present their findings at a conference. Please note that only 4 Units can be accredited towards major requirements in the case a student undertakes 8 Units for both PC3288/R and PC3289/R.
